name: fuzzy-files
author: lumine-code
description: Quickly find and take an action over project files.
backgroundTips: You can open any file in the project by typing part of its name with {{ 'fuzzy-files:toggle' | keystroke }}
You can send the file you picked in the finder straight into a split pane with {{ 'select-list:split-right' | keystroke }}

ignoredNames.title: List of ignore glob patterns
ignoredNames.description: Files and directories matching these patterns are ignored. This list is merged with the list defined by the core `Ignored Names' configuration setting.

separator.title: Type of separator in file paths
separator.description: Type of separator for the file path when copying or pasting.
